```{r}
r_b_gamache <- read_csv("/home/raphael/R/SABER/inst/extdata/r_b_gamache_obs.csv")

spectra_df <- r_b_gamache %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = wavelength,
    values_from = r_b,
    names_prefix = "wl_"
  )

# spectra_df: columns = class, and one column per wavelength OR a matrix list
# Suppose you have: class, and columns named like wl_350, wl_351, ... or numeric names
wl_cols <- grep("^wl_", names(spectra_df), value = TRUE)

eps <- 1e-8
shrink_cov <- function(S, lambda = 0.1) {
  D <- diag(diag(S))
  (1 - lambda) * S + lambda * D
}

fit_class_gaussians <- function(df, lambda = 0.1) {
  X <- as.matrix(df[, wl_cols])
  # mean-normalize each spectrum (row)
  m <- rowMeans(X)
  Xn <- X / (m + eps)

  mu <- colMeans(Xn)
  S  <- cov(Xn)
  S  <- shrink_cov(S, lambda = lambda)
  L  <- chol(S)

  list(mu = mu, L = L, n = nrow(Xn))
}

fits <- spectra_df %>%
  group_by(class) %>%
  group_split() %>%
  map(~fit_class_gaussians(.x, lambda = 0.1))

classes <- spectra_df %>% distinct(class) %>% pull(class)
K <- length(classes)

# mixture weights from library proportions
counts <- map_int(fits, "n")
rb_pi <- counts / sum(counts)

rb_mu_k <- lapply(fits, `[[`, "mu")
rb_L_k  <- lapply(fits, `[[`, "L")
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(ggplot2)

# --- identify wavelength columns ---
wl_cols <- grep("^wl_", names(spectra_df), value = TRUE)
wavelength <- as.numeric(sub("^wl_", "", wl_cols))

eps <- 1e-8
shrink_cov <- function(S, lambda = 0.1) {
  D <- diag(diag(S))
  (1 - lambda) * S + lambda * D
}

fit_class_gaussian <- function(df, lambda = 0.1) {
  X <- as.matrix(df[, wl_cols, drop = FALSE])
  Xn <- X / (rowMeans(X) + eps)          # mean-normalize each spectrum (shape only)

  mu <- colMeans(Xn)
  S  <- cov(Xn)
  S  <- shrink_cov(S, lambda = lambda)

  sd <- sqrt(diag(S))
  list(mu = mu, sd = sd, Xn = Xn)
}

lambda <- 0.1  # adjust if needed for stability
fits <- spectra_df %>%
  group_by(class) %>%
  group_split() %>%
  set_names(map_chr(., ~ unique(.x$class))) %>%
  map(~ fit_class_gaussian(.x, lambda = lambda))

# --- long-form normalized library spectra for plotting ---
lib_long <- spectra_df %>%
  select(class, all_of(wl_cols)) %>%
  mutate(.row = row_number()) %>%
  pivot_longer(all_of(wl_cols), names_to = "wl", values_to = "R") %>%
  group_by(.row) %>%
  mutate(Rn = R / (mean(R) + eps)) %>%    # mean-normalize per spectrum
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(wavelength = as.numeric(sub("^wl_", "", wl))) %>%
  select(class, .row, wavelength, Rn)

# --- per-class mu +/- sd bands ---
mu_sd_long <- imap_dfr(fits, function(fit, cls) {
  tibble(
    class = cls,
    wavelength = wavelength,
    mu = fit$mu,
    sd = fit$sd,
    lo = fit$mu - fit$sd,
    hi = fit$mu + fit$sd
  )
})

# --- plot ---
ggplot() +
  geom_line(
    data = lib_long,
    aes(x = wavelength, y = Rn, group = interaction(class, .row), color = class),
    linewidth = 0.4, alpha = 0.35
  ) +
  geom_ribbon(
    data = mu_sd_long,
    aes(x = wavelength, ymin = lo, ymax = hi, fill = class),
    alpha = 0.15, linewidth = 0
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data = mu_sd_long,
    aes(x = wavelength, y = mu, color = class),
    linewidth = 1.1
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "wavelength (nm)",
    y = "Normalized bottom reflectance (mean-normalized)",
    title = "Bottom library (normalized) and fitted class Gaussian prior: μ ± 1σ"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(legend.title = element_blank())
```

```{r}
# ---- Bottom replicate spectra: low-rank PCA prior ----
rb_obs <- read_csv("/home/raphael/R/SABER/inst/extdata/r_b_gamache_obs.csv") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    class = as.character(.data$class),
    wavelength = as.numeric(.data$wavelength),
    r_b = as.numeric(.data$r_b)
  )

# identify replicate id if present; otherwise fabricate within class
id_col <- intersect(names(rb_obs), c("time_target"))
if (length(id_col) == 0) {
  rb_obs <- rb_obs %>%
    group_by(class) %>%
    arrange(wavelength, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(rep_id = cumsum(c(1, diff(wavelength) < 0))) %>%
    ungroup()
  id_col <- "rep_id"
} else {
  id_col <- id_col[1]
}

spectra_df <- rb_obs %>%
  dplyr::select(class, dplyr::all_of(id_col), wavelength, r_b) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = wavelength, values_from = r_b, names_prefix = "wl_")

wl_cols <- grep("^wl_", names(spectra_df), value = TRUE)
wl_native <- as.numeric(sub("^wl_", "", wl_cols))
ord <- order(wl_native)
wl_cols <- wl_cols[ord]
wl_native <- wl_native[ord]

X_native <- as.matrix(spectra_df[, wl_cols, drop = FALSE])
wl_target <- as.numeric(wavelength)

# interpolate each replicate spectrum onto Stan grid
X <- t(apply(X_native, 1, function(row_vals) {
  y <- as.numeric(row_vals)
  ok <- is.finite(y)
  if (sum(ok) < 2) return(rep(NA_real_, length(wl_target)))
  interp1(wl_native[ok], y[ok], wl_target)
}))  # [n_spec, n_wl]

# fill any non-finite with column medians
if (any(!is.finite(X))) {
  col_med <- apply(X, 2, function(z) stats::median(z, na.rm = TRUE))
  for (j in seq_len(ncol(X))) {
    bad <- !is.finite(X[, j])
    if (any(bad)) X[bad, j] <- col_med[j]
  }
}

cls_vec <- spectra_df$class
classes <- sort(unique(cls_vec))
K <- length(classes)

# global PCA basis (shared across classes)
mu_global <- colMeans(X)
Xc <- sweep(X, 2, mu_global, "-")
p <- stats::prcomp(Xc, center = FALSE, scale. = FALSE)

q_eff <- min(q, ncol(p$rotation), ncol(X))
rb_U <- p$rotation[, 1:q_eff, drop = FALSE]  # [n_wl, q]

rb_mu_k <- vector("list", K)
rb_tau_k <- vector("list", K)
rb_sigma2_k <- numeric(K)
counts <- integer(K)

for (i in seq_along(classes)) {
  cl <- classes[i]
  idx <- which(cls_vec == cl)
  counts[i] <- length(idx)
  
  Xk <- X[idx, , drop = FALSE]
  mu_k <- colMeans(Xk)
  rb_mu_k[[i]] <- as.numeric(mu_k)
  
  # residuals around class mean
  Rk <- sweep(Xk, 2, mu_k, "-")        # [n_k, n_wl]
  Ak <- Rk %*% rb_U                    # [n_k, q]
  tau <- apply(Ak, 2, stats::sd)
  tau[!is.finite(tau)] <- 0
  tau <- pmax(tau, tau_floor)
  rb_tau_k[[i]] <- as.numeric(tau)
  
  Rhat <- Ak %*% t(rb_U)
  Ek <- Rk - Rhat
  sigma2 <- mean(Ek^2)
  sigma2 <- max(sigma2, sigma2_floor)
  rb_sigma2_k[i] <- sigma2
}

names(rb_mu_k) <- classes
names(rb_tau_k) <- classes
rb_pi <- counts / sum(counts)
```
